lgr.scope: Gateshead is one of seven North East unitary/metropolitan authorities (County Durham, Gateshead, Newcastle, Northumberland, North Tyneside, South Tyneside, Sunderland) under the North East Mayoral Combined Authority. Kim McGuinness (Labour/Co-op) elected as first North East Mayor on 2 May 2024 with 41% of vote. Devolution deal worth over 4.2bn GBP over 30 years.
lgr.savings_implication: Mayoral combined authority delivers transport plan + additional investment but does not reorganise Gateshead Council's statutory functions

actionable_savings_levers_summary: PFI exposure is the structural drag: Schools PFI (Pinnacle, 7 schools, to July 2034) plus STWWMP waste PFI with Sunderland + South Tyneside; both lock unitary charges with RPIX uplift (12.61% in 2023/24 schools PFI). Renegotiation / handback windows are scarce but should be modelled
34.4m cumulative MTFS gap to 2029/30 with only 6.1m efficiencies plus 5.9m social care interventions identified = 14.8m unidentified savings target remaining over 5-year horizon
Reserves smoothing of 12.5m over 2025/26-2026/27 to fund ASC transformation - if transformation under-delivers, reserves will breach 3% minimum

Schools Forum 2024/25 papers flag High Needs Block possibly entering deficit; statutory override extension to 2028 buys planning runway but Gateshead has not located in Safety Valve / DBV agreement list
Net revenue budget 346m for 2026/27 - significantly smaller scale than London boroughs in EFS, but reserves replenishment from 2027/28 is conditional on delivering planned transformation pipeline
Asset Management Strategy 2022-2027 due for refresh; non-domestic asset reviews underway - capital receipts trajectory needs publication
North East Devolution Deal (4.2bn over 30 years via NEMCA) is upside funding lever via transport / housing not direct revenue support
